Written by hand.
A module outside the org that carries a generate directive and never asks for
it to run: its go.mod holds no //go:gendep line. It compiles as the zip
published it, which is a package that declares nothing.

-- .mod --
module example.com/generatedunasked

go 1.16
-- .info --
{"Version": "v1.0.0"}
-- go.mod --
module example.com/generatedunasked

go 1.16
-- gen/main.go --
package main

import (
	"flag"
	"os"
)

func main() {
	out := flag.String("out", "", "file to write")
	flag.Parse()
	body := "package lang\n\nfunc Name() string { return \"generated\" }\n"
	if err := os.WriteFile(*out, []byte(body), 0o666); err != nil {
		os.Exit(1)
	}
}
-- lang/lang.go --
//go:generate go run example.com/generatedunasked/gen -out lang.gen.go

// Package lang declares nothing itself: Name is the generator's to write.
package lang
